name: netlify
label: Netlify
description: Netlify is a platform for building and deploying websites and apps.

get_site.label: Get Site
get_site.description: Get the details of a site, including its URLs, build settings and published deploy.

get_site_by_id.label: Get Site by ID
get_site_by_id.description: Get the details of a site given its ID or domain.

siteId.label: Site ID
siteId.description: The Netlify site ID (API ID, a UUID) or the site domain such as my-site.netlify.app. Use List Sites to find it.

start_deploy.label: Start Deploy
start_deploy.description: Start a new build and deploy of a site from its Git repository.

siteId.label: Site
siteId.description: The site to build and deploy.

clearCache.label: Clear Build Cache
clearCache.description: Clear the build cache before building.

start_deploy_by_id.label: Start Deploy by Site ID
start_deploy_by_id.description: Start a new build and deploy of a site given its ID or domain.

siteId.label: Site ID
siteId.description: The Netlify site ID (API ID, a UUID) or the site domain such as my-site.netlify.app. Use List Sites to find it.

clearCache.label: Clear Build Cache
clearCache.description: Clear the build cache before building.

get_deploy.label: Get Deploy
get_deploy.description: Get a deploy by its ID, including its state, branch, commit and URLs.

deployId.label: Deploy ID
deployId.description: The Netlify deploy ID, e.g. 6512f0c1a2b3c40008d9e123 (from List Site Deploys or a deploy trigger).

cancel_deploy.label: Cancel Deploy
cancel_deploy.description: Stop a deploy that is still queued or building.

deployId.label: Deploy ID
deployId.description: The ID of the queued or building deploy to cancel.

restore_deploy.label: Publish Deploy (Rollback)
restore_deploy.description: Publish an earlier deploy so it becomes the live version of its site.

deployId.label: Deploy ID
deployId.description: The ID of the deploy to publish (from List Site Deploys).

lock_deploy.label: Lock Deploy
lock_deploy.description: Lock a published deploy so new builds do not replace it (stops auto publishing).

deployId.label: Deploy ID
deployId.description: The ID of the deploy to lock, usually the one currently published.

unlock_deploy.label: Unlock Deploy
unlock_deploy.description: Unlock a deploy so new builds are published automatically again.

deployId.label: Deploy ID
deployId.description: The ID of the locked deploy.

list_files.label: List Files
list_files.description: List the files of the published deploy of a site.

siteId.label: Site
siteId.description: The site whose files to list.

list_files_by_id.label: List Files by Site ID
list_files_by_id.description: List the files of the published deploy of a site given its ID or domain.

siteId.label: Site ID
siteId.description: The Netlify site ID (API ID, a UUID) or the site domain such as my-site.netlify.app. Use List Sites to find it.

list_forms.label: List Forms
list_forms.description: List the forms of a site with their submission counts.

siteId.label: Site
siteId.description: The site whose forms to list.

list_forms_by_id.label: List Forms by Site ID
list_forms_by_id.description: List the forms of a site given its ID or domain.

siteId.label: Site ID
siteId.description: The Netlify site ID (API ID, a UUID) or the site domain such as my-site.netlify.app. Use List Sites to find it.

list_env_vars.label: List Environment Variables
list_env_vars.description: List the environment variables of a site.

siteId.label: Site
siteId.description: The site whose variables to list.

context.label: Deploy Context
context.description: Only variables with a value for this context.

scope.label: Scope
scope.description: Only variables available in this scope.

list_env_vars_by_id.label: List Environment Variables by Site ID
list_env_vars_by_id.description: List the environment variables of a site given its ID or domain.

siteId.label: Site ID
siteId.description: The Netlify site ID (API ID, a UUID) or the site domain such as my-site.netlify.app. Use List Sites to find it.

context.label: Deploy Context
context.description: Only variables with a value for this context.

scope.label: Scope
scope.description: Only variables available in this scope.

set_env_var.label: Set Environment Variable
set_env_var.description: Create an environment variable on a site or change its value.

siteId.label: Site
siteId.description: The site to set the variable on.

key.label: Key
key.description: Variable name, e.g. API_URL (letters, digits and underscores).

context.label: Deploy Context
context.description: Which deploys get this value. All contexts replaces any per-context values. Defaults to all contexts.

isSecret.label: Secret
isSecret.description: Only used when the variable is created: hide its value in the Netlify UI and API. Secret variables are available to builds, functions and runtime only and need a specific deploy context.

set_env_var_by_id.label: Set Environment Variable by Site ID
set_env_var_by_id.description: Create or change an environment variable on a site given its ID or domain.

siteId.label: Site ID
siteId.description: The Netlify site ID (API ID, a UUID) or the site domain such as my-site.netlify.app. Use List Sites to find it.

key.label: Key
key.description: Variable name, e.g. API_URL (letters, digits and underscores).

context.label: Deploy Context
context.description: Which deploys get this value. All contexts replaces any per-context values. Defaults to all contexts.

isSecret.label: Secret
isSecret.description: Only used when the variable is created: hide its value in the Netlify UI and API. Secret variables are available to builds, functions and runtime only and need a specific deploy context.

delete_env_var.label: Delete Environment Variable
delete_env_var.description: Delete an environment variable from a site.

siteId.label: Site
siteId.description: The site to delete the variable from.

key.label: Key
key.description: The variable name to delete, e.g. API_URL.

delete_env_var_by_id.label: Delete Environment Variable by Site ID
delete_env_var_by_id.description: Delete an environment variable from a site given its ID or domain.

siteId.label: Site ID
siteId.description: The Netlify site ID (API ID, a UUID) or the site domain such as my-site.netlify.app. Use List Sites to find it.

key.label: Key
key.description: The variable name to delete, e.g. API_URL.
